model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: 2026 Subaru Solterra Specifications. Saved as sources/subaru-2026-solterra-specifications.pdf. The 2027 press kit has no spec sheet and says it 'continues with the same lineup as the 2026 model'.

width_in.note: 'Width'; the sheet doesn't say whether mirrors are included. C/D lists the same figure as width without mirrors.

awd.note: 2026 press kit: 'Every 2026 Solterra is equipped with standard Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive'. 2027 press kit: 'Standard Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive'.

charge_port.note: 2026 press kit: 'All 2026 Solterra models feature a North American Charging Standard charging port'. 2026 spec sheet: 'NACS charge inlet on right fender'. 2027 press kit: 'All 2027 Solterra models feature a North American Charging Standard (NACS) charging port'.

supercharger_access.note: Subaru release, Oct. 22, 2025: 'The 2026 Subaru Solterra EV is equipped with the North American Charging Standard (NACS) port, which is compatible with applicable Tesla Superchargers'; 'all owners of Subaru Solterra models now have easier access to more than 25,000 Tesla Superchargers'.

cross_check.note: Tesla lists Subaru among manufacturers with access to NACS Superchargers; 'For new vehicles that are NACS-equipped, no adapter will be necessary.' Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-supercharging-other-evs-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: 2027 press kit: 'The 2027 Subaru Solterra EV arrives at retailers nationwide this fall.' 2026 press kit said the 2026 would be 'Available at retailers nationwide later this fall' (2025).

epa_range.note: 2026 matches the year of the spec sheet quoted. EPA's 2027 listings (50690, 50689) carry the same figures. EPA's labels name the wheel size, not Subaru's trims.

cargo_cu_ft.note: C/D 2026 Premium AWD, cargo space behind the second row and behind the front row.

turning_circle_ft.note: C/D 2026 Premium AWD, 'Turning Diameter / Radius, curb to curb (feet)'.
